meta.name: airunway-aks-setup
meta.description: Set up AI Runway on AKS — from bare cluster to running model. Covers cluster verification, controller install, GPU assessment, provider setup, and first deployment. WHEN: "setup AI Runway", "onboard AKS cluster", "install AI Runway", "airunway setup", "deploy model to AKS", "GPU inference on AKS", "KAITO setup on AKS", "run LLM on AKS", "vLLM on AKS", "set up model serving on AKS", "AI Runway controller".

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按步骤在已有 AKS 集群上完成 AI Runway 搭建:先核对集群和 GPU,再安装控制器与推理服务(如 KAITO),最后部署并验证第一个模型;每一步都会汇报进度,安装或部署前先征求同意。
howto.when: 当你说“setup AI Runway”“install AI Runway”“deploy model to AKS”等短语,或要求给已有 AKS 集群搭建/续跑 AI Runway 时,就会触发。

say.note: 会跳过前面已完成的步骤,从第 3 步开始。

howto.what_en: After setup, Claude walks through AI Runway deployment on your AKS cluster: checks cluster/GPU, installs controller and inference provider (e.g. KAITO), deploys and verifies first model. Reports step status and asks before installing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "setup AI Runway", "install AI Runway", "deploy model to AKS", or ask to set up/resume AI Runway on an existing AKS cluster.
